name: Nishi-Oi
tagline: Shinagawa in 5 minutes and Shibuya in 11 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, where JR East run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 21 minutes to Otemachi, 16 minutes to Shinjuku, 11 minutes to Shibuya and 5 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 15.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 8.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 15.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 14 m to 22.2 m, a difference of 8.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 1 clinic. The nearest hospital is 仁生堂大村病院, about 13 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 佐花会大井中央病院, about 18 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. JR Yokosuka Line run through it. JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line also call here. Both lines are run by JR East, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: JR Yokosuka Line runs at 138% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 武蔵小杉→西大井, which includes this station. JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000, 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000, 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Togoshi-Koen is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is, but Nishi-Oi is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 13 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Nishi-Oi.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
